newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE PLAYER FINED BY BANNED CHAIRMAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE PLAYER FINED BY BANNED CHAIRMAN.

text.p: Fenerbahce have fined international midfielder Kemalettin Senturk 500 million Turkish lira ($4,300) after he was sent-off on Sunday for allegedly swearing at a referee.

"We didn't fine Kemalettin for getting a red card, but for his amateurish behaviour," said club chairman Ali Sen, who watched Sunday's match from a specially partitioned part of the stands after being banned from the directors' box for insulting a referee during a match in December.
"Such an action (as Kemalettin's) doesn't befit a Fenerbahce member," Sen said.
